case.title: A/R Summary: ticked customers and ranges survive reload and Back
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have two customers, customer A and customer B, with invoices more than 90 days past due on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
case.custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick customer A and customer B.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days".
  3. Reload the page.
  4. In the Past due filter, untick "91+ days".
  5. Click the browser's Back button.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chip reads "Customer: 2 customers".

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Past due: 91+ days".

Step 3:

  • Both customers and "91+ days" are still ticked after the reload.

Step 4:

  • The chip reads "Past due: Any".

Step 5:

  • "91+ days" is ticked again.
  • Both customers are still ticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R19: “The ticked customers or vendors and the ticked Past due ranges are kept in the page address like Location (S5-R10).”
  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”

Last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-past-due-ticked.png: figure "Past due ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-two-customers-ticked.png: figure "Two customers ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19." (caption of "Two customers ticked")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")

AUTOMATION: READY
